en: The image shows the address side of an old Spanish postcard printed with the heading 'TARJETA POSTAL UNION POSTAL UNIVERSAL ESPAÑA'. There are dotted guide lines for writing the address, handwritten recipient information in ink, and a red Spanish postage stamp in the upper-right corner with a circular postal cancellation mark. The card has a worn, slightly yellowed appearance typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
